desc: Ideation: directed edge constraints (red moves orthogonally, blue diagonally), parity argument forces R even; R=0 needs B even; mixed feasible for all even R≥2, any B≥0.

Write complete solver with feasibility check and three constructions (all-red, all-blue, mixed), verify on sample and edge cases (R=0,B=2; R=0,B=3; R=2,B=1; R=2,B=3; R=4,B=0; large mixes), checking wrap-around adjacency and distinct squares.
